capabilities: Display a monthly calendar of daily notes in the right sidebar
Create a daily note for a date using the current template
Open or create weekly notes by clicking week numbers
Preview an existing note on Ctrl/Cmd hover
Reveal the active note in the calendar
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later and is installed manually from release files. Runs entirely locally with no analytics or network calls; interface language can follow Obsidian or be set to Chinese or English.
intentEvidence: Settings from Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin.
problem: Browsing daily notes by date is awkward because Obsidian's core Daily Notes feature offers no calendar showing which days have notes or unfinished tasks.

relations.evidence: Its calendar functionality is inspired by Liam Cain's obsidian-calendar-plugin.

summary: Sidebar calendar that shows which dates have daily notes, creates missing ones from a template, and opens weekly notes.
